policies.title: Canadian citizens: no visitor visa or eTA
policies.summary: Canadian citizens do not need a visitor visa or eTA to enter Canada.
conditions: Canadian citizens need a valid Canadian passport for air travel; land or sea travel can use another accepted identification document.
Most dual Canadian citizens need a Canadian passport; American-Canadian citizens may use a valid Canadian or United States passport with proof of Canadian citizenship when using the latter.

policies.title: United States citizens: no visitor visa or eTA
policies.summary: United States citizens do not need a visitor visa or eTA to enter Canada.
conditions: Carry proper identification; a valid United States passport is the recommended universally accepted travel and identification document.
United States lawful permanent residence is a separate status-based no-eTA exception and is not normalized to a passport nationality code.

policies.title: Ordinary passports from unqualified eTA-required nationalities
policies.summary: Citizens of these eTA-required nationalities need an eTA, not a visitor visa, to board a flight to Canada with a valid ordinary passport.
conditions: Applies to air travel or airport transit with a valid passport; an eTA does not guarantee entry.
For land or sea arrival by car, bus, train, or boat including a cruise ship, an eTA is generally not needed but a valid passport is still required.
A traveller by sea from Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, other than on a cruise ship, needs an eTA to board the boat.

This policy does not absorb nationality-specific passport qualifiers, citizenship, permanent-residence, refugee, stateless, alien-document, transit, crew, military, diplomatic, or refuelling exceptions.

application.label: Government of Canada eTA application
steps: Travel by air or transit through a Canadian airport with a valid passport from an eTA-required nationality.
Complete the official online eTA form and pay the required fee.
Travel using the same passport linked to the approved eTA.

policies.title: eTA-required nationalities with passport or British-status conditions
policies.summary: eTA eligibility for these nationality codes depends on the stated issuing authority, passport feature, or British citizenship status.
conditions: GB: applies to British citizen passports. British national overseas, British overseas citizen, British overseas territory citizen, and British subject documents require the source's stated status, right-of-abode, re-admissibility, or territorial-connection conditions and are not separate ISO nationality codes.
HK: passport must be issued by the Hong Kong SAR; this does not cover Macao SAR passports, which are visa-required.
IL: passport must be a national Israeli passport; an Israeli Travel Document in Lieu of National Passport is visa-required.
RO: passport must be electronic; non-electronic passports, including temporary passports, are visa-required.
TW: passport must be an ordinary Ministry of Foreign Affairs passport containing the holder's personal identification number; other Taiwan documents are visa-required.
VA: passport or travel document must be issued by the Vatican City State.
Air, land/sea, Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, and eTA application conditions follow the unqualified eTA policy.

application.label: Government of Canada eTA application
steps: Confirm that the passport or British-status condition in the official country table is met.
Complete the official online eTA form using that passport or travel document.
Travel by air with the same document linked to the approved eTA.

policies.title: Ordinary passports from visa-required nationalities
policies.summary: These ordinary-passport nationalities require a valid visitor visa and passport to visit or transit Canada by air, land, or sea.
conditions: Applies by air, car, train, bus, or boat including a cruise ship.
The 17 specifically listed eTA-X nationalities are excluded because their visa requirement has a conditional air-travel eTA route.
Stateless individuals and holders of refugee travel documents need a visa, but those document categories are not normalized to nationality codes.
This ordinary-passport cohort does not replace the stated Israeli, Romanian, or Taiwan document-specific rules.

policies.title: Visa-required nationalities with conditional eTA-X air-travel route
policies.summary: These nationalities remain visitor-visa-required unless all eTA-X conditions are met; this is not universal eTA eligibility.
conditions: An eTA may be used only for a temporary stay normally up to six months when flying to or transiting through a Canadian airport with a valid passport.
The traveller must have held a Canadian visitor visa within the previous 10 years or hold a valid United States nonimmigrant visa on the eTA application date.
A valid United States nonimmigrant visa need not remain valid on the Canada travel date.
If any condition is not met, a visitor visa is required.
A visitor visa is required for arrival by car, bus, train, or boat, including a cruise ship, even where an eTA-X route would otherwise be available.
A valid existing Canadian visitor visa can be used until expiry and removes any need for an eTA.

application.label: Government of Canada eTA application
steps: Confirm the nationality, air-travel, temporary-stay, and prior Canadian visitor-visa or valid United States nonimmigrant-visa conditions.
Apply online for an eTA using the passport to be used for travel, or apply for a visitor visa instead.
Use a visitor visa for land or sea arrival.
